U4: Google Protocol Buffer codec option for serialize/deserialize objects.

Technical and design decisions:
- Extend existing xd-yarn bash script with an `info` subcommand that uses ZooKeeper CLI/Curator to fetch admin port from the existing ZK node.
- Implement reactor stream processor module as a new module type/plugin analogous to existing Spark and RxJava modules, using Reactor's `Processor` interface; minimal configuration via module options.
- Add a configurable message header enricher that, when enabled, injects stream name, module name, and other history metadata into message headers.
- Implement Protocol Buffers codec using Google's protobuf-java library, integrating with Spring XD's codec SPI.
- For Ambari plugin, create an Ambari service definition (metainfo.xml, scripts in Python) that manages Spring XD admin and container processes via existing init scripts and REST API.
- For JDBC-HDFS partitioned jobs, keep existing mutual exclusion validation (sql vs tableName when partitionColumn used) and document it; ensure both sql-based and tableName-based partitioned jobs can be defined as per U8 by adjusting metadata validation if needed.
- Test framework: use existing Spring XD test harness and JMH or simple timing for performance tests.

Assumptions:
- The existing Spring XD codebase is available, buildable, and the developer is familiar with its module architecture.
- ZooKeeper is already used by Spring XD on YARN for storing admin port; the ZK path is known or discoverable from existing code.
- Reactor library is compatible with the Spring XD version and can be added as a dependency.
- Google Protocol Buffers library (protobuf-java) version compatible with Java 17+ (or the XD's Java baseline) is available.
- Ambari plugin will target a recent Ambari version with standard service plugin structure; only basic lifecycle management (install, start, stop, status) and monitoring via REST is required, not full HA.
- Documentation will be written in the project's wiki (Markdown/Confluence) as part of repo or external; effort includes screenshots/examples.
- Performance test results documentation is lightweight, not a full benchmarking suite.
- All estimates are for a single experienced developer, in workdays (8 hours), and exclude unrelated production support.

Effort: 4 days.

A2: U1 - Implement `info` command in xd-yarn script.
Description: Add a subcommand to the existing xd-yarn bash script that queries ZooKeeper for the admin server port of the current deployment and prints it, avoiding manual ZK queries.
Effort: 2 days.

A3: U2 - Implement Reactor-based stream processor plugin.
Description: Create a new module plugin (similar to Spark/RxJava) allowing a reactor processor module to specify just the processor class; wire minimal config and support module options for additional configuration.
Effort: 6 days.

A4: U3 - Add message history tracking header option.
Description: Implement an option to enrich messages with headers containing stream name, module name, etc., configurable per stream/module.
Effort: 3 days.

A5: U4 - Implement Protocol Buffers codec.
Description: Add a Protobuf codec option using Google protobuf-java for serialization/deserialization, integrated with Spring XD codec framework.
Effort: 4 days.

A6: U5 - Test coverage and performance evaluation for complex objects.
Description: Develop unit/integration tests for complex/serialized objects (Protobuf, nested/tree objects) and measure/document performance characteristics using the test harness.
Effort: 4 days.

A7: U6 - Develop Ambari plugin for Spring XD cluster management.
Description: Create an Ambari service plugin (metainfo, Python scripts, REST monitoring) to provision, manage, and monitor Spring XD clusters.
Effort: 12 days.

A8: U7 - Document partitioned job options and metadata validation logic.
Description: Author wiki documentation explaining the use of 'partitions', required tableName/columns, mutual exclusivity of sql/tableName, and the JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata assertion logic.
Effort: 2 days.

A9: U8 - Enhance/validate sql vs tableName options for partitioned jobs.
Description: Ensure job definition metadata allows either sql (with where clause) or tableName/columns (strict table-column) for partitioned jobs; adjust validation if needed and add tests.
Effort: 3 days.

A10: Integration testing, build, and release packaging.
Description: Integrate all changes, run full test suite, fix defects, build distribution, and prepare release artifacts for the increment.
Effort: 4 days.

A11: Code review, documentation polish, and final verification.
Description: Self-review code, refine docs (including U7 wiki), verify all user stories met, and finalize effort.
Effort: 2 days.
